author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
Clears the last four fixable Dependabot alerts.

#2029 took `dompurify` from 3.1.7 to 3.4.8 by bumping `monaco-editor` to 0.56.0, which resolved 16 of the 20 open dompurify alerts. Four remain, each needing a later patch than monaco pins:

| Advisory | Severity | Vulnerable | Patched |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [GHSA-vxr8-fq34-vvx9](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vxr8-fq34-vvx9) | low | `< 3.4.9` | 3.4.9 |
| [GHSA-cmwh-pvxp-8882](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cmwh-pvxp-8882) | medium | `<= 3.4.10` | 3.4.11 |
| [GHSA-c2j3-45gr-mqc4](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c2j3-45gr-mqc4) | low | `<= 3.4.11` | 3.4.12 |
| [GHSA-55q2-fjhq-7xh7](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-55q2-fjhq-7xh7) | medium | `<= 3.4.12` | 3.4.13 |

`dompurify` is transitive through `monaco-editor`, which pins it exactly at 3.4.8, so an override is the only lever until monaco ships a release pinning `>= 3.4.13`. Same shape as the three overrides in #2030.

Resolves to 3.4.14 after install. Reversible the moment monaco catches up.

## Remaining after this

Two alerts, both `image-size <= 2.0.2` ([GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq), [GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr)), reached through `metro` ← `expo`. Neither has a patched release at any version, so there is nothing to override to. The pending Expo v57 bump does not help — a newer `metro` inherits the same unfixed dependency.

That takes the board from 31 open alerts to 2, both genuinely unfixable and both understood.

## Verification

- `pnpm check` exit 0
- `pnpm test` 16/16 tasks
- `pnpm build` 10/10 tasks
- Post-install resolution: `dompurify@3.4.14`
title: fix(deps): override dompurify to clear the last four advisories
